issue_title: Crashes when GIT_DIR is a relative path, and the common prefix of paths to check includes a directory.
issue_text_snapshot: Decision-time reproduction excerpt only. Summary: Darker crashes when GIT_DIR is a relative path and the common prefix of paths to check includes a directory such as src. Example command: GIT_DIR=.git darker --check src. Observed behavior: command reports Not a git repository and raises subprocess.CalledProcessError from git diff --name-only --relative HEAD -- . while running through darker.__main__.main, format_edited_parts, darker.git.git_get_modified_files, and _git_check_output_lines. Expected behavior: darker --check src should complete without that git repository error. Solution-analysis sections from the issue body are intentionally excluded from this snapshot.
target_behavior_description: Running Darker with a relative GIT_DIR and path argument src should not crash before completing the check. The issue-derived harness should reproduce the pre-patch git repository error using only the selected source commit and the redacted issue reproduction steps.
reproduction_steps: Clone the Darker repository and check out the source commit selected at or before the issue creation timestamp.
Install the selected source commit in an isolated environment using its project metadata.
Run the Darker command against src with GIT_DIR=.git in the environment.
Confirm the pre-patch behavior reproduces the issue-described git repository failure.
expected_failure_type: subprocess.CalledProcessError or command failure matching the issue-described git diff repository error
notes: Issue-derived seed from GitHub issue #112. Uses a redacted decision-time issue snapshot containing reproduction and observed failure only. Solution-analysis sections are excluded. No native future test, fixed commit, PR patch, or gold evidence is used.
